```{r}
install.packages("mlbench")
library(mlbench)
library(ggplot2)
data(BostonHousing2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(BostonHousing2, aes(x = tax, y = chas, color = chas)) +
  geom_boxplot(col = "purple") + theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Full-Value Property-Tax Rate per USD (10,000)")
```
